description: Walk or run to a destination on your current lot. Prerequisite: you are joined to the lot the target lies on; the destination tile is routable (no wall, locked door, or blocking object in the path the engine computes). Effect: the lot's authoritative VM plans a path and queues a goto-action on your action queue; you animate the movement over in-sim seconds proportional to distance. You arrive at or within ~1 tile of the target on success. On failure (pathfind-blocked, caller-interrupted, target moved), your Sim stops where blocked and a dialog may fire. Cost: real seconds of session time equal to the path length divided by tiles-per-second; no motive cost beyond the natural decay during movement. Specify destination exactly one of three ways — absolute (x,y,level), by target_object_id from your nearby_objects perception feed, or by target_sim_id for a nearby Sim. Target lookups resolve against your local VM at the moment of invocation; if the target has moved by the time the lot VM plans the path you may end up at their old position.

args.name: x
args.description: Absolute target x in 1/16-tile units (range 0..32767). Ignored if target_object_id or target_sim_id is set.

args.name: y
args.description: Absolute target y in 1/16-tile units. Ignored if target_object_id or target_sim_id is set.

args.name: level
args.description: Floor level (1 = ground). Ignored if target_object_id or target_sim_id is set (resolved from target position).

args.name: target_object_id
args.description: ObjectID of an object in your nearby_objects perception slice. Takes precedence over x/y. Level is inherited from the object's current position.

args.name: target_sim_id
args.description: PersistID of a nearby Sim to approach (from nearby_sims). Highest precedence.

args.name: interaction
args.description: Goto-object interaction index: 2=Walk Here, 4=Run Here. Default 4 matches the stock client's pie-menu Run Here.

args.name: param0
args.description: Optional goto-object param0, forwarded to VMNetGotoCmd.
